text: 据美国媒体CBS报道，周四上午，美国国务院官员参加了自2023年10月7日以来，亚伯拉罕协议签署国（美国、以色列、阿拉伯联合酋长国、巴林和摩洛哥）的首次正式会议。周四，哈萨克斯坦官员首次加入《亚伯拉罕协议》缔约国行列。哈萨克斯坦去年曾表示有兴趣加入该协议。美国代表团由国务院高级官员、政治事务副国务卿艾莉森·胡克率领。此次会议由总部位于美国的N7基金会主办，该基金会自2021年以来一直召集《亚伯拉罕协议》各国的多边会议。N7 基金会创始人、会议主席杰弗里·塔尔平斯说道，“下一阶段的重点是深化现有关系，并为各国合作寻找切实可行的机会。”
text_en: According to U.S. media outlet CBS, on Thursday morning, U.S. State Department officials participated in the first formal meeting since October 7, 2023, of the signatories to the Abraham Accords (the United States, Israel, the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, and Morocco). On Thursday, Kazakh officials joined the ranks of parties to the Abraham Accords for the first time. Kazakhstan expressed interest in joining the accords last year. The U.S. delegation was led by senior State Department official and Under Secretary for Political Affairs Allison Hooker. The meeting was hosted by the U.S.-based N7 Foundation, which has convened multilateral meetings of Abraham Accords countries since 2021. N7 Foundation founder and conference chairman Jeffrey Talpins said, "The next phase focuses on deepening existing relationships and finding practical opportunities for cooperation among countries."
